governance.note: The 2026-07-10-nyiso-59-dynamic-rr keeper recipe VERBATIM with exactly ONE change, and it is a MEASURED-DATA swap, not a tuned parameter (rules 12/13, zero new free parameters): the downstate CT-peaker delivered-gas index moves from the v1 monthly statewide citygate premium (nyiso_downstate_ct_gas_basis, EIA N3050NY3 minus Transco Z6 NY, floored 0) to the MEASURED per-zone DAILY LDC-transport delivered index (nyiso_downstate_ct_gas_daily; the nyiso-downstate-gas curated datatype v2): delivered_gas[zone][day] = Transco Z6 NY daily commodity spot + the zone's LDC monthly non-firm transportation delivery rate (KEDNY SC-22 Tier 1 for NYC / KEDLI SC-19 Tier 1 for Long Island, published statnfdr statements). This is nyiso-55's G-13 mechanism folded into the keeper line: the interruptible peakers are TRANSPORT customers (commodity at the market hub + a published tariff delivery charge), not firm-sales citygate customers, and the LI gas island vs the NYC system carry materially different delivery costs; the daily hub leg captures the cold-snap blowouts (Jan-2024 $23.90, 2025-01-17 $97.90) on the exact days the peakers run, which the monthly mean smears away. Every component is measured and forward-native (rate cases step the delivery rate; the daily spot reprices; regenerates for a forward year and responds to changed conditions). One mechanism per phenomenon (rule 19): v1 OFF, v2 ON - superseded, not stacked. Engagement: 105 downstate CT_PEAKER units repriced per year; delivered ranges 2.45-30.84 (2023), 2.76-26.52 (2024), 4.18-100.87 (2025) $/MMBtu across zones NYC/Long_Island. The dual-fuel oil-parity min still caps winter spikes (runs after). All other mechanisms (measured hourly reserve requirements #1344 B2+B3, measured zonal load shares, Zone-K LCR/TSL, measured neighbor hub import pricing, CAMPD outage overlay, F923 fuel costs, plant emission rates v2) carried UNCHANGED from the keeper.
governance.residuals_note: A/B RESULT (vs the nyiso-59 keeper at the same HEAD, v2.4 load-weighted price basis): a metrics wash-to-slightly-better on price level/shape with the scarcity tail unchanged. C3a 2023 PASS -4.8% (keeper -4.8%), 2024 -13.2% (keeper -13.2%), 2025 -13.7% (keeper -15.7% - the daily index prices the Jan/Feb-2025 cold-snap months the monthly premium smeared); C3b 2023 0.163 PASS, 2024 NRMSE 0.223 (keeper 0.221), 2025 0.199 - INSIDE the 0.20 band (keeper 0.215, ledgered): one ledgered caveat DROPS vs the keeper. C3c >$300 model tail identical to the keeper: 2023 23h (DA actual 1, RT 10 - the ledgered G-20a scoring-basis artifact), 2024 1h PASS (DA 0, RT 12), 2025 25h vs DA 12 = 2.08x, marginally outside [0.5,2.0] (RT actual 42 - the model sits 17h UNDER the RT tail), same ledgered artifact. C1 fuel-mix 14/14 PASS all years (free 10/10), C2 PASS, C4 PASS, C7 PASS (ST_GAS D-1 r 0.950-0.957, cv_ratio 0.681-0.902), C8 clean PASS via the v2.2 grounded-above-budget escalation (ST_GAS reliability_floor 32.1/44.0/36.0% forced; D-4 off-window 0.0% in the declared h0-23 window; keeper read 30.3/44.5/38.0%). C5a CO2 +3.3/+2.5/+8.1% - 2025 in the commercial band (auto-caveat; keeper read +8.6%). Per rule 1 the swap is kept on its measured basis (per-zone daily measured delivered index > monthly statewide stand-in - the exact promotion logic of nyiso-56's measured load shares and nyiso-59's measured hourly requirements), NOT on the residual movement. Zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (2026-07-10-nyiso-60-ldc-transport-ablation).

_open_items: (1) 2024 (mild year) + 2025 DEEP (>$300) price tail still under the RT actual - next structural lever remains downstate import discipline: the MEASURED NYC locality import limit is 2,875 MW (capacity-deliverability) vs the model's 3,900 MW Dunwoodie-South energy-TTC estimate; apply in the summer-peak window as the Zone-K TSL (#1345) does for LI (single-delta probe nyiso-61). (2) #1344 B1 residual: condition-varying largest-contingency / forecast-uncertainty increments - formal NYISO Market Operations request only; the derived requirement series is a documented lower bound in non-TSA hours; the 2024 deep-tail undershoot (1 vs 12 RT h) sits here. (3) Iroquois Z2 winter hub (Ask-C, licensed-data ask) - the Dec-2024/Dec-2025 winter level has no measured monthly anchor. (4) C3c is scored on the DA-expressible basis (G-20a) - the RT-like tail the co-opt produces (23/1/25 h) is not credited until settlement-price scoring lands; 2025 trips the DA gate at 2.08x while sitting 17h UNDER the RT actual. (5) G-13 (LI/NYC delivered-fuel basis) is CLOSED by this run - the per-zone daily LDC-transport index supersedes the v1 statewide citygate stand-in; residual sharpening (true daily citygate commodity index from ICE/Platts/NGI) is optional, not blocking. CI replay of this recipe OOMs GitHub-hosted runners in regenerate_clean - solve locally with >= 15 GB + swap.
